اخرنطمن (form IIIq)
# اِخْرَنْطَمْنَ (iḵranṭamna) /ix.ran.tˤam.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِخْرَنْطَمَ (iḵranṭama)
# اِخْرَنْطِمْنَ (iḵranṭimna) /ix.ran.tˤim.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِخْرَنْطَمَ (iḵranṭama)
